sourceEvidence.note: Dealer source URLs retained from prior research ledger, but published mark was not selected as a suitable image-edit target. Concept is not an official replacement.

generation.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: original independent car dealer logo concept, transparent PNG.
Primary request: design a very refined contemporary logo for EXACT text "Ginza Motors", and no other words.
Concept: a bespoke two-stroke G monogram with clean rectangular negative-space aperture, inspired by disciplined Japanese graphic modernism without using any Japanese symbols or characters; pair with exquisitely kerned "Ginza Motors" wordmark.
Style: authoritative minimal flat vector; striking and restrained, strong enough for premium car showroom signage, no generic sports-car clichés.
Palette: ink-black and vivid but sparingly placed vermilion red; flat solid fills only.
Composition: horizontal lockup centered with generous true transparency; readable in desktop/mobile headers and mark separable for 32px.
Constraints: exact spelling "Ginza Motors", no extra copy, no gradients, no metallic glow, no supercar outline, no rising sun flag, no watermark, no mockup or background rectangle. This is not the dealership's official mark.

holdReasons: Genuine source branding not visually compared against concept
Separate compact mark and on-dark/accent variants incomplete
No maintained pack or six-design visual release checks
